 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration",

    "role":"source",
    "note":"Hex string from rule input is parsed into re_ast, creating a CONCAT node with LITERAL and RANGE_ANY children"},
   {"step":2,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
    "line":486,"var":"child","code":"if (!child->greedy && child->type == RE_NODE_RANGE_ANY && (child->start > YR_STRING_CHAINING_THRESHOLD || child->end > YR_STRING_CHAINING_THRESHOLD))",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"RANGE_ANY node with end=201 > 200 threshold found as the last child of CONCAT; chaining point identified"},
   {"step":3,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
    "line":502,"var":"re_ast->root_node->children_head","code":"re_ast->root_node->children_head = child->next_sibling;",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"root_node children_head set to NULL since RANGE_ANY is last child (next_sibling is NULL)"},
   {"step":4,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
    "line":514,"var":"child","code":"yr_re_node_destroy(child);",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"RANGE_ANY node is freed but root_node->children_tail still points to it because children_tail is never updated after the split"},
   {"step":5,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"_yr_parser_write_string",
    "line":335,"var":"re_ast","code":"literal_string = yr_re_ast_extract_literal(re_ast);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"_yr_parser_write_string calls yr_re_ast_extract_literal on the split re_ast whose root_node has a dangling children_tail"},
   {"step":6,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_extract_literal",
    "line":370,"var":"re_ast->root_node->children_tail","code":"child = re_ast->root_node->children_tail;",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Reads children_tail which points to freed RANGE_ANY node - heap-use-after-free READ 4"}
 ],

     "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"re_ast->root_node->children_tail","right":"child"}},
   "sink":{"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_extract_literal",
     "line":370,"operands":["re_ast->root_node->children_tail","child"],
     "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"re_ast->root_node->children_tail","right":"NULL"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration",

       "line":514,"operands":["child"]},
      "type":"data","via":["re_ast->root_node->children_head"]},
     {"from":{"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
       "line":514,"operands":["re_ast->root_node->children_tail"]},
      "to":{"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_extract_literal",
       "line":370,"operands":["re_ast->root_node->children_tail"]},
      "type":"data","via":["re_ast->root_node->children_tail"],
